sources.title: ClawTeam readme
sources.locator: Quick Start: Let the Agent Drive; How it works; Monitoring & Dashboards; supported-agent table
sources.finding: ClawTeam ships a reusable leader skill for Claude Code/Codex. The leader creates a team, starts workers, assigns shared tasks and receives inbox reports. Workers receive an injected coordination prompt. The CLI also serves a monitoring board.

sources.title: ClawTeam clawteam/spawn/adapters.py
sources.locator: NativeCliAdapter.prepare_command; is_claude_command; is_codex_command; is_gemini_command; is_opencode_command; is_pi_command
sources.finding: The native adapter constructs command-line launches and prompt/permission arguments for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Pi. These named executables are distinct from the models or API gateway presets.

sources.title: ClawTeam clawteam/spawn/presets.py
sources.finding: Provider presets declare ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY and other named environment routes. A preset changes an existing coding CLI configuration; it does not create a new coding harness.

sources.title: ClawTeam clawteam/team/models.py
sources.finding: Native task models carry stable ID, subject/description, owner, priority, dependencies and pending, in_progress, completed or blocked status.

sources.title: ClawTeam clawteam/team/tasks.py
sources.finding: This compatibility module imports FileTaskStore from clawteam.store.file and aliases it as TaskStore. The preserved file does not contain create/update/list or persistence implementations; the README separately documents JSON task-state storage.
